title: AI Learning Capability Manager
description:
AI Learning Capability Manager

Our client is urgently looking for an experienced AI Learning Capability Manager, with good demonstrable experience with AI to join their team on an 18-month Fixed-Term basis.

Our client is looking to get AI embedded at scale – a more structured and measurable manner, into the delivery of our client’s services across the group.

This new role will lead the learning, capability and people-adoption workstream behind that rollout - building the knowledge, confidence and judgement our people need to use AI effectively, responsibly and commercially - working closely with colleagues responsible for AI strategy, technology, governance and implementation.

You will be rewarded with an excellent salary, as well as a brilliant benefits package including, hybrid 2 days on-site, pension scheme (4% matched), 3x life cover, cash plan, sick pay, salary sacrifice and many, many more perks!

AI Learning Capability Manager – Key Skills:

  • Significant experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Organisational Development, Capability Development or a related discipline.
  • Strong experience diagnosing capability requirements and translating them into effective development solutions.
  • Excellent understanding of adult learning, experiential learning, learning design and behaviour change.
  • Experience designing and facilitating practical learning for varied audiences.
  • Strong practical understanding of generative AI and its application within the workplace
  • Confident user of AI tools with the ability to translate complex concepts into accessible, practical learning.
  • Understanding of responsible AI use, limitations, verification and appropriate human oversight.
  • Experience supporting organisational, digital or technology-enabled change and adoption.
  • Strong consulting, facilitation and stakeholder-management capability.
  • Ability to influence and constructively challenge without relying on formal authority.
  • Collaborative approach to working with other learning professionals and subject-matter experts.
  • Commercial mindset and ability to connect capability development with business outcomes.
  • Comfortable managing a delivery budget and running practical, squad-by-squad embedding activity (recipe-card test kitchens, department huddles) without dedicated coordinator or support staff.
  • Ability to operate effectively across multiple businesses, functions and levels of seniority.
  • Experience within legal, professional services or another regulated, knowledge-based environment.


AI Learning Capability Manager


Due to the volume of applications received for positions, it will not be possible to respond to all applications and only applicants who are considered suitable for interview will be contacted.
